Subject: CAIQ: privileged operator controls — evidence procurement and timeline

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. As we begin the CAIQ mapping for Aurum Financial I want to gather the minimal set of artifacts that map to the privileged operator / keystore / secret-management controls. For CAIQ reviewers the typical asks we get are:

- proof of ephemeral/operator session issuance (audit logs)
- keystore rotation runbook and last rotation timestamp
- privileged access policy and recent attestations
- MFA enforcement for operator sessions and jump-hosts
- examples of support/maintenance access approvals (ticket + approval)

I've attached a short worksheet with the control-to-artifact request to keep things concrete (priv-op-evidence-request.xlsx). Can you confirm:

1) an SFTP or secure Drive upload we should expect (link or contact)
2) whether you can provide operator audit logs for Dec 2026 (CSV preferred)
3) a target timeline — we typically aim to pull the bundle within 10 business days for an initial submission to the CAIQ portal.

If there are internal constraints (redactions, PII carve-outs) flag them and we'll plan for an interim attestation.

Thanks — looping Marissa and Priyom for intake and collection.

Rachel Kim
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
attachment: priv-op-evidence-request.xlsx (Excel, 35KB)

Rachel —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers:

1) We can provision an SFTP drop and a gated Google Drive folder. Security will share SFTP credentials via a separate encrypted message.
2) We can export operator session audit logs for Dec 2026 — will be CSV. Note: we need to redact internal user GUIDs per policy; timestamps and session ids remain intact.
3) 10 business days is doable for the initial bundle assuming no formal legal redaction requests.

A couple of clarifying questions from our team to make sure the artifacts align to the CAIQ fields:
- When you say "keystore rotation runbook" do you want the full internal runbook or a redacted PDF that shows the process + last rotation entry?
- For privileged approvals, are examples of ticket approvals (Jira IDs) sufficient, or do you require a signed attestation as well?

I'll have our security ops lead (cc'd) drop the SFTP path and a short inventory by EOD Friday.

—Jordan Reeves
Head of Infrastructure Security
Aurum Financial
